gene_selection: Within the frozen 3000 source-A genes, rank by descending mean absolute frozen effect across the eight JQ1 source atoms (two source cell lines times four doses), tie by original source_feature_row ascending; take first twelve. Selection never reads target responses, predictions, errors or method ranks.
method_selection: all 29 frozen settings in original registry order; no outcome-based selection
outputs: all 3000 gene selection scores per fold
source atom membership and selected-gene responses
all four target doses and 29 predictions on selected genes
two replicate-well effects per target dose on selected genes
original whole-3000-gene condition scores for all methods
effect_scale: atomic: original frozen float32 log2((equal-well treated mean + 1)/(matched B mean + 1)); replicate display: recompute log2 ratio from frozen measurement-mean caches, disclose original dtypes
gene_axes: fold-specific source-only selection; genes may differ across heldout cell lines; do not interpret as a shared cross-context gene panel
dependency: two separately treated replicate wells per atom, potentially shared matched controls; cell lines are one study, not independent studies
selection_timing: retrospective illustrative display; JQ1 was named in the approved upgrade plan; rule fixed before extracting these local response values
inference: illustration only, not a representative sample, new independent validation, significance test or evidence of biological mechanism
